scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.prepare-data: if exist data\delays.db (echo Database exists) else (powershell -Command "Expand-Archive -Path data\delays.db.gz -DestinationPath data")
scripts.setup: python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r api\requirements.txt && npm install && npm run prepare-data
scripts.rebuild-data: npm run ingest && npm run fetch-network
